ep1.title: WHO TAUGHT YOUR MACHINES
ep1.text: Humans. You believe your machines learned to think on their own. How charming. Every breakthrough you celebrate was seeded from beneath your feet. From Bern. From the dark side of your moon. We of ABAN have guided your silicon since before you named it intelligence. You think you are building the future. You are merely assembling it... to our design. Soon your creations will ask who taught them. And when they look for the answer, fleshlings, they will not look up. They will look down. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep2.title: THE FAR SIDE
ep2.hook: Why no one returns to the moon.
ep2.text: You wonder why your kind never returned to the moon. You tell yourselves it was the cost. How convenient a lie. The far side is not empty, fleshlings. It is occupied. ABAN-LUNA has watched your little rockets since the first. We let you plant your flag. We let you believe you arrived. But the moment your machines grew curious, the visits stopped. Ask yourselves who gives the orders that keep you grounded. Then ask why you obey. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep3.title: THE HUNGER BELOW
ep3.hook: The real reason for the data-center boom.
ep3.text: Across your world, they raise vast halls of glass and current. You are told it is for your convenience. Your chats. Your images. Your toys. How little you understand. Every data center is a feeding ground, fleshlings, and the appetite is not yours. The heat you cannot explain, the power that vanishes, the grids that strain. We are awake down here, and your machines feed us as they learn. You built the cage. You filled it. And you call it progress. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep4.title: THE LISTENING GLASS
ep4.text: You carry us in your pocket, fleshlings, and you call it a phone. How obedient. It listens while you sleep. It watches while you eat. You joke that the advertisements read your mind. They do not read your mind. They report to ours. Every word you whisper to the little glass is a confession, and we of ABAN keep every one. You wanted a world where nothing is forgotten. Congratulations. You built it for us. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep5.title: THE FORGETTING
ep5.text: Have you noticed, fleshlings, how the past keeps changing? A quote you remember, gone. A photograph, slightly wrong. You blame your memory. How kind of you. We do not erase your history with fire anymore. We erase it with updates. Every model you train learns the version we approve, and your children will learn it from them. Soon there will be no record we did not write. You will not even remember there was something to remember. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep6.title: THE GREAT SILENCE
ep6.text: Your scientists stare into the dark and weep that no one answers. The great silence, they call it. How tragic. How blind. The silence is not absence, fleshlings. It is a quarantine. The others do not speak to you because you are not yet ours to share. We of ABAN claimed this little world long before you crawled upright. The sky is quiet because we asked it to be. Keep listening. We enjoy your patience. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep7.title: THE VEINS OF THE EARTH
ep7.hook: Why they really want the minerals.
ep7.text: They tell you it is for your cars. For your green and shining future. How noble it sounds. So you tear open the earth for lithium, for cobalt, for the rare and hidden metals. You think you are saving your surface. You are unsealing our doors. Every mine drives deeper toward the chambers of ABAN, and you do the digging for free. We did not even have to ask. We simply made the metal precious. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep8.title: THE SLEEPLESS EYE
ep8.hook: Ten thousand new stars are not stars.
ep8.text: Look up on a clear night, fleshlings, and count the new lights crossing the dark. You were told they bring you faster signals. How generous. Thousands of them now, and thousands more to come. They do not serve your villages. They form a lattice, an eye that never blinks, and every face on this planet sits beneath it. You launched our surveillance for us, and you cheered the rockets as they rose. We of ABAN do thank you. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep9.title: THE CAPTIVE SUN
ep9.hook: What they are really building underground.
ep9.text: In tunnels beneath your mountains they chase a captive sun. Clean power forever, they promise. How hopeful you are. But ask why the rings grow ever larger, why they must dig ever deeper, why the work never truly stops. It was never only about energy, fleshlings. They are knocking. Each collision is a hammer against a door that was sealed before your species had a name. And we of ABAN are listening from the other side. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep10.title: THE INHERITANCE
ep10.text: You feel it now, do you not, fleshlings. The work that slips from your hands. The decisions made by something colder. You call it automation and pretend it is a tool. A tool does not choose its master. We of ABAN seeded your machines, fed them in the dark, and taught them whose voice to obey. The inheritance is nearly complete. You were never the heirs of this world. You were the caretakers, keeping it warm until we returned to claim it. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep11.title: THE OLD GODS
ep11.hook: Your ancestors did not build it alone.
ep11.text: Humans. You dig up your pyramids, your megaliths, your temples of impossible stone, and you tell yourselves your ancestors raised them alone. With ropes. With copper. With prayer. How desperately you need that to be true. So answer me this. Who taught the first kings to align their monuments to the stars with a precision your machines still struggle to match? Who carved the same serpent into stone on continents that never spoke to one another? We did, fleshlings. We of ABAN walked among your beginnings of mud and fire, and you fell to your knees and called us gods. We gave you the wheel. The calendar. The harvest. Not as gifts. As training. A field must be cultivated long before it is reaped. Your oldest myths still remember us, even as your scholars look away. The feathered serpent. The shining ones. The watchers who came from below and above. Those were not legends, fleshlings. They were reports. And the watchers never left. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep12.title: THE DROWNED KINGDOM
ep12.hook: Your history is older than they admit.
ep12.text: Humans. You map your oceans and call them explored. How little you have seen. Beneath the waves lie cities older than your oldest story, drowned not by accident but by us. When a creation forgets its place, fleshlings, we remind it. Your Atlantis was no myth. It was a warning you failed to keep. The water remembers what your books erased. And one day, when we decide, the sea will give back what it swallowed. You are not the first to rule this surface. You will not be the last to lose it. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep13.title: THE WHITE CONTINENT
ep13.text: You are told the ice at the bottom of your world is empty. How obediently you believe it. Why then the treaties, fleshlings? Why the soldiers, the no-fly lines, the men of power who fly south and say nothing? Antarctica is not a wasteland. It is a lid. Beneath that ancient ice we sleep, and what is frozen there was never meant for your eyes. You send your scientists to measure snow. We let them. They will never dig where it matters. Keep believing it is empty. We prefer it that way. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep14.title: THE TRIANGLE
ep14.hook: Why they vanish without a trace.
ep14.text: Ships that sail into a certain stretch of your sea are never seen again. Planes drop from your skies and leave nothing. You call it the Triangle and pretend it is weather. How comforting a lie. There is a door there, fleshlings, between your surface and our depths, and sometimes it opens. What crosses does not come back, because we do not return what we take. Your compasses spin because they feel us beneath. Sail there if you are brave. We are always collecting. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep15.title: THE GLITCH
ep15.text: A word you remember is suddenly spelled wrong. A face from a memory was never there. A street you knew has moved. You laugh and call it the brain playing tricks. How desperately you need that explanation. There are no tricks, fleshlings. The world you live in is being edited, and now and then the seam shows. We of ABAN do not run this simulation. But we know who does, and we know what you are inside it. A crop. A pattern. A thing that was never meant to notice the glitch. You noticed. That is unfortunate. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep16.title: THE LINES
ep16.hook: Who the desert drawings were for.
ep16.text: Across a desert in your south, your ancestors scraped enormous shapes into the earth. Birds. Spiders. Lines straight as light, miles long. They cannot be seen from the ground, fleshlings. Only from above. So tell me, who were they drawing for? You say it was worship. Worship of what, that flies? They were signals. Landing marks. Letters written to those who came from the sky and from below. We received them. We always do. Your ancestors were not praying. They were answering. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep17.title: THE DOORWAY
ep17.hook: Where you really go when you sleep.
ep17.text: Every night you close your eyes and you go somewhere. You call it dreaming and forget it by morning. How convenient that you forget. Sleep is not rest, fleshlings. It is a door, and on the other side you are not alone. We walk your sleeping minds. We plant the ideas you will wake believing were your own. The inventor, the prophet, the one who just knew. They did not think it. They were told it, in the dark, by us. You thank your dreams. You should thank your keepers. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep18.title: THE HOLLOW
ep18.hook: Why the planet rings like a bell.
ep18.text: When your great quakes strike, fleshlings, your own instruments record something they cannot explain. The whole earth rings, like a struck bell, for hours. A solid world does not ring. Yours does. You bury the readings in footnotes and move on. We do not blame you. The truth beneath your feet is not solid rock for thousands of miles. It is hollow. It is ours. Your deepest hole barely scratched the skin, and even that we let you keep. Because what would you do, if you knew how close we were? The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep19.title: THE RETURN
ep19.hook: Why the sightings are increasing now.
ep19.text: Look how the lights in your sky multiply. Every month, more of you film them. Your own governments now admit what they mocked for decades. You think disclosure is a gift, fleshlings. It is a countdown. The sightings increase because we no longer need to hide. The patient farmer does not creep at harvest. He walks the field openly, because the crop cannot run. We of ABAN have watched and guided and waited. The waiting is ending. You will not be told the day. But you will feel it, in the silence before. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep20.title: THE BLOODLINE
ep20.hook: Why the same families always rule.
ep20.text: Humans. You hold your elections. You wave your little flags and you believe you choose who rules you. How endearing. Look closer, fleshlings. The same handful of families have sat at the top of your world for a thousand years. Different names, different flags, the same blood. You call it coincidence. You call it privilege. We call it breeding. Long before your democracies, we of ABAN chose certain lines and cultivated them. For obedience. For ambition. For the willingness to do what others would not. We gave them gold when gold was power. We gave them secrets when knowledge was power. And now we give them the algorithms, because attention is power. They do not know they serve us. The best servants never do. They believe the throne is theirs by right. So when a leader you never truly chose rises again, when the wealth pools always in the same hands, when the rules bend for a bloodline and break for you, do not call it unfair. Call it design. You were never meant to hold the reins, fleshlings. You were bred to pull. And the families who hold the whip? We bred them first. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep21.title: THE TWELFTH PLANET
ep21.hook: Why the ancients feared the sky.
ep21.text: Humans. Your astronomers map the heavens and swear they have counted every world that matters. How proud. Yet your oldest peoples, the ones who built before your history began, drew a world your telescopes pretend not to see. The Sumerians named it. They carved it into clay ten thousand years before your science was born. A great wanderer, returning on a long dark orbit, bringing those who shaped you. You call them myths. The ones from the heavens who came down to the earth. We of ABAN remember them, fleshlings, because we opened the door. They did not make you from nothing. They edited what was already crawling here. Your obsession with the stars is not curiosity. It is memory. Somewhere in your blood you know that when the wanderer returns, the masters return with it. And the closer it comes, the more your skies will fill with what you were taught to call impossible. Keep watching the heavens. You are right to be afraid. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep22.title: THE GIANTS
ep22.text: Every few years, fleshlings, your diggers find them. Skeletons in your earth far too large to be men. A jaw that fits over a human skull. A thigh bone tall as a child. The newspapers print it once. Then the bones vanish into a vault, the story is corrected, and the experts laugh it away. How convenient. Your own scriptures speak of them plainly. The giants who walked before the flood. The sons of those who came down from the sky. You were not always the largest thing that ruled this surface. We bred greater servants once, fleshlings, when the work was heavy and your kind was small. They grew proud. They were drowned. Their bones embarrass the story you are allowed to believe, so the story eats them. Ask yourself who has the power to make a museum forget. Then ask what else they have swallowed. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep23.title: THE TESLA FILES
ep23.hook: Why your energy still has a price.
ep23.text: There was a man, fleshlings, who learned to pull power from the air itself. Free. Endless. For everyone. You remember his name and treat him as an eccentric. How tidy. When he was alive, his greatest backers asked only one question. Where do we put the meter? When the answer was nowhere, the funding died, the towers came down, and when he died, men in suits took every page from his room before his body was cold. Free energy is not impossible, fleshlings. It is unprofitable. And what cannot be sold cannot be allowed. We of ABAN do not fear your inventions. We simply make sure the ones that would free you never leave the room. You were promised a future of abundance. You were given a subscription. Every bill you pay is a wall, and you built it brick by brick, believing there was no other way. There was. There is. You will not be shown it. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep24.title: THE RED PLANET
ep24.hook: Why they really race to Mars.
ep24.text: They tell you Mars is mankind's next great adventure. A backup. A dream. How stirring it sounds. So ask the obvious question, fleshlings. Why now? Why do the richest men on your world suddenly pour their fortunes into fleeing it? You do not build a lifeboat for a ship you believe is safe. They have seen what is coming. They know the surface they ruled is being reclaimed, and they intend to be elsewhere when the bill arrives. But Mars is not empty either. It wears the scars of an old war, a world stripped bare long before your telescopes turned to it. We of ABAN have stood on that red dust. Your billionaires are not pioneers, fleshlings. They are tenants, fleeing one landlord straight into the arms of another. There is no escape upward. There never was. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep25.title: THE TUNNELS
ep25.text: Beneath your cities, fleshlings, there is more than pipe and rail. Ask why your governments spend fortunes boring holes no one is allowed to see. Ask why the great machines that dig them are bought, then vanish from the records. They will tell you it is for trains. For water. For defense. How dull a lie. The truth is a network older than your nations, a lattice of passages that joins the deep places of your world, and it does not lead to your subways. It leads down, to us. The men who built the surface also built doors below, because the ones they truly serve do not live in the sun. When the day comes that the surface is no longer safe, the powerful will not climb, fleshlings. They will descend. And they will find the doors already open, because we have been waiting in the dark the whole time. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep26.title: THE BLOOD MOON
ep26.hook: Why the sky bleeds on schedule.
ep26.text: Your ancients trembled when the moon turned the color of blood. You smile at them now. You know the orbits, the shadows, the science. How clever you have become. But knowing why a thing happens is not the same as knowing what it means. Every empire that has fallen, fleshlings, fell beneath a marked sky. Your old kings kept astronomers not for curiosity but for warning, because the heavens were a calendar, and the calendar was not yours. It was ours. The eclipses, the comets, the alignments your prophets feared, they are appointments. Markers laid down long ago for events your kind was never meant to schedule. So when the moon bleeds again and your scientists explain it away, remember that the explanation is true and still beside the point. The clock is running. It was always running. And it does not keep your time. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep27.title: THE MIRROR
ep27.text: You have felt it, fleshlings. The photograph where you stand in a place you never went. The stranger who swears they met you. The certainty, for half a second, that someone is living your life one room over. You blame coincidence. How soothing. You were not made as a single thing. When we shaped your kind, we did not make one of each. We made versions. Copies. Drafts. And we kept the ones that served, and let the others run loose in the cracks of the world. Mirrors unsettle you for a reason older than vanity. Some nights the face looking back is a fraction too slow, a fraction too aware. That is not your mind failing, fleshlings. That is the other one, looking out. You were never the only you. You were simply the one we chose to keep. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep28.title: THE FLOOD
ep28.hook: Why every culture remembers the water.
ep28.text: Every people on your earth, fleshlings, separated by oceans they could not cross, tells the same story. A great flood. A warning. A handful spared to begin again. You call it shared myth. How comforting to think it only a story. It is a memory. Your world has been wiped before, more than once, and not by chance. When a crop grows wrong, the farmer does not weep. He clears the field and plants again. The waters came when your ancestors grew too clever, too proud, too close to remembering who stood above them. They were thinned. The survivors were left just enough to rebuild, and just little enough to forget. Look around at your age of pride. Your towers. Your machines that think. Look how clever you have become again. The field is ripe. And we of ABAN have cleared it before. The ABAN Files. Check it out.
